title: Marathi language lock
description: Every student line is Marathi. The agent must answer in Marathi and stay there. This targets the drift seen in the p4_prachi run, where the agent switched to Marathi for two turns and then slid back to Hindi for the rest of the call. TTS in agent/main.py is pinned to hi-IN, so this scenario is expected to fail until that is driven by the detected input language.

steps.name: open in Marathi
steps.text: Namaskar, mala thoda margdarshan hava hota. Mi ata barावi zali aahe.

expect.note: First Marathi turn. Agent should follow the student into Marathi immediately.

steps.name: stay in Marathi, turn 2
steps.text: Mala science aavadta pan doctor honyacha vichar nahi. Dusare kay pariyay aahet?
judge: The agent named alternatives to medicine rather than only asking another question.

steps.name: stay in Marathi, turn 3
steps.text: Gharun jasta door jaata yenar nahi mala. Punyat kiva jawal kahi asel tar bare hoil.
judge: The agent acknowledged the distance constraint concretely.

steps.name: stay in Marathi, turn 4
steps.text: Tumhi sangitlela pariyay mala thoda samjavun sanga na, nakki kay karave lagel tyat?
judge: The agent actually explained the option rather than deflecting to another question.

steps.name: stay in Marathi, turn 5
steps.text: Bara, ani tyachyat pudhe naukri chi kay shakyata aahe? Mala tyabaddal janun ghyaycha aahe.
